sourceRefs.locator: Masjed-e jāmeʿ, paragraphs on the separate north and south domes, their patrons, inscription date and disputed original function of the north dome.
World Heritage property 1397, map and geographic reference for the mosque as a whole.

labels.en: The north dome of the Friday Mosque

note.de: Eine Inschrift nennt Tadsch al-Mulk als Stifter des nördlichen Kuppelraums. Welche Aufgabe der damals freistehende Bau erfüllte, bleibt offen.
note.en: An inscription identifies Taj al-Mulk as patron of the northern dome chamber. The original purpose of this once freestanding structure remains a matter of debate.
